_: The future-context scenarios for 70-76 Riley Street: scripts/future_context.ts draws them over the capacity study's data. Properties are named by the start of their address as the NSW property register writes it. A building is a footprint type (single: single loaded, 12 m deep; d18: double loaded, 18 m, 8 units a floor; d22: double loaded, up to 22 m, 10 units a floor, east and west facing; block: the whole parcel, apartments on every face that is not a party wall; consent: as approved; podium: the street wall over the whole parcel), its storeys, and the line its long axis follows: `along` a street or the party wall of a `neighbour`, `setback` metres off that line, `depth` metres deep from it (the type's depth unless smaller), `sides` off each end, `length` at most (45 m whatever is asked), kept `from` a named street's end with `endSetback` off it, or `centre`. `footprint: lot` fills the parcel. Prose may use {A.area}, {A.plate}, {A.fsr}, {A.parity}, {A.gap} and {units}. `site.tower` draws our own scheme as a podium and a tower inset from the lot by the setbacks named per street or neighbour; `site.tower.habitable` says which of its faces carry habitable rooms or balconies. A scenario's own `retained` list overrides the study's. A scenario's own `site.tower` moves our tower for that sheet. This file holds the paired amalgamations of the blocks round the site; the main file focuses on the Crown Street site south of the lane lot.

tower._: The SSDA plans (Fuse Architects, Aug 2026): a 4-storey podium over the lot, the tower 3 m off Riley Street and Crown Lane, 3.7 m off Stanley Lane and 9 m off 66-68 Riley Street; apartments from level 2 of the podium (the ground floor commercial). `units` lays them out as the plans do, face by face from the north end, each as [number, width in metres, corner flag where the unit also has windows on that end wall]: the tower (levels 05-13 plan) 7 a floor, 3 on Crown Lane and 4 on Riley Street; the podium (level 03 plan) 10 a floor, 5 and 5, its north wall a party wall.

scenarios.title: Today
scenarios.horizon: What stands now, with our tower in it
scenarios.lead: Every building at the height the 3D tiles read for it, our tower as the model draws it: the separations and the sun the neighbours have today, and what our tower takes from them.
notes: Nothing new round the site; the storeys are the tiles' heights at 3.1 m a storey.
The sun table lists every neighbour: its apartments with two hours as it stands, and without our tower.

scenarios.title: Paired amalgamations · north pairs
scenarios.lead: Owners of the small single titles sell together, but the strata at 62-64 Riley St and the corner terraces hold out. Two mid-size sites appear, each big enough for one slab but not for a tower.
notes: 54-60 Riley St with 1 Crown Lane become one site of {A.area} m². It takes a double-loaded 18 m slab along Yurong Lane, {A.plate}, {A.storeys} storeys, {A.gap} m off the strata to its south.

The three Crown St lots south of 93-95, with 10 Crown Lane behind them, become one site of {B.area} m². A single-loaded 12 m slab sits against the party wall of the new building at 107-113, {B.plate}, {B.storeys} storeys, every unit facing north over a {B.gap} m court.
93-95 Crown St builds its approved boarding house.
62-64 Riley St is left between two taller neighbours, which is what eventually pushes it into the full amalgamation.

scenarios.lead: The two Yurong Lane corners go first: on Riley St the DA site takes 58 with it, on Crown St the corner terrace and the lane lot behind it pair up. Everything south of them, the strata included, stays.

89 Crown St with 4 Crown Lane behind it: {B.area} m², a single-loaded slab along Yurong Lane, {B.plate}, {B.storeys} storeys, every unit facing north over the lane.
93-95 Crown St builds its approved boarding house.
The new slabs stand at the far end of each block, {A.sep} and {B.sep} m from our tower: the mid-term option that touches us least.

scenarios.lead: The commercial strata at 62-64 Riley St sells with the two small titles north of it, and on Crown St the consent at 93-95 is folded into one site with the three lots south of it. These are the mid-term slabs that stand nearest our tower.

Its south face stands {A.sep} m from our tower, across the retained strata: at {A.storeys} storeys the ADG asks 24 m between habitable rooms, so that face, or ours, must be blank.
93-99 Crown St with 10 Crown Lane: {B.area} m², a double-loaded slab against the 4 Crown Lane boundary, {B.plate}, {B.storeys} storeys, {B.gap} m off 105 Crown St; parity at {B.parity}.
54-56 Riley St with 1 Crown Lane, 89 Crown St with 4 Crown Lane, and 105 Crown St stay as they are.

89-95 Crown St with 4 Crown Lane: {B.area} m², a double-loaded slab along Yurong Lane in place of the boarding-house consent, {B.plate}, {B.storeys} storeys, parity at {B.parity}.
99-105 Crown St: {C.area} m², a single-loaded slab against the party wall of 107-113, {C.plate}, {C.storeys} storeys, every unit facing north.
